name: reuse-me
description: Audit repository health, declarations, usage, and component intent with deterministic static signals.

interface.shortDescription: Map repo structure, declarations, usage, and drift.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local capability-driven static analyzer in whole-repository health mode or current-diff mode. Produces deterministic repository, declaration, relationship, usage, and component reuse signals before agents read source files.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repo for health and usage signals.
